annotations.text: a continuation paragraph genuinely belongs to its item, and losing that is a **silent** loss — atomized alone, "Model calls go through one interface with two backends" reads as a system-wide requirement and can be placed in the wrong family with nothing marking it as suspect.
Measured on this repository: 3 of 649 list items are affected, so the cost of the fix is small and so is the blast radius of getting it wrong.
the item's lines are not contiguous when a sub-list sits between them, which would break the verbatim-slice property F3's span guard depends on.
